title: 闺怨
author: 王昌龄
intro: A carefree young wife dresses up on a spring day — until one glance at the green willows makes her regret sending her husband away to seek glory.
analysis: “闺怨”是古诗里一类常见的题材，写女子在家里思念远方丈夫的哀怨。可这首诗开头却说这位年轻的妻子“不知愁”：春天到了，她精心打扮，高高兴兴地登上翠楼看风景。转折发生在第三句：她忽然看见路边的杨柳又绿了。柳树代表春天，也代表离别（古人送别时折柳相赠），这一眼让她想到：又一年过去了，丈夫还在远方。最后一句写出她的心事：真后悔当初让他去求取功名！诗人没有写她哭，也没有写她说什么，只写了一个“忽见”、一个“悔”字，情绪就从无忧无虑变成了深深的思念和后悔。这种先扬后抑、在一个瞬间里写出心情突变的写法，非常巧妙。诗的背后也有对唐代人追求边功、夫妻长久分离的感叹。
analysisEn: Poems called guī yuàn, “boudoir laments”, were a standard type in Chinese poetry: a woman at home pining for a husband far away. But this one starts by telling us the young wife “knows no sorrow”. It is spring; she does her make-up carefully and climbs her green-painted tower in high spirits to enjoy the view. The turn comes in line three: she suddenly sees the willows along the road have turned green again. Willows mean spring — and partings, since people broke off a willow twig when seeing someone off. That one glance reminds her that another year has passed and her husband is still far away. The last line gives us her thought: how she regrets telling him to go off and win a noble title! The poet doesn’t show her crying or speaking; with just “suddenly saw” and “regret” her mood flips from carefree to longing and remorse. Building her up as happy and then letting one small sight bring her down is what makes the poem so neat. Behind it is a quiet comment on the Tang fashion for seeking fame on the frontier, which kept so many couples apart.
background: Wang Changling (c. 698–757), a leading High Tang poet, wrote many quatrains in a woman’s voice as well as frontier poems. Seeking a title (封侯) through service in the army was a common ambition of young men in his time.
pronunciation: 少妇 shào fù（年轻的妇女，不读 shǎo）。“悔教”的“教”表示“让、使”，按《现代汉语词典》读 jiào；也有注本读 jiāo。机器朗读可能读成 jiāo，已在“朗读用字”换成同音字“叫”。凝妆 níng zhuāng。觅 mì。
version: 采用通行本（《唐诗三百首》、《全唐诗》）。首句有异文“闺中少妇不曾愁”，网站用通行的“不知愁”。

lines.py: guī zhōng shào fù bù zhī chóu
lines.lit: In her chamber the young wife does not know sorrow;
lines.en: The young wife in her chamber has never known sorrow;

lines.py: chūn rì níng zhuāng shàng cuì lóu
lines.lit: on a spring day, fully made up, she climbs the green tower.
lines.en: one spring day, dressed in her finest, she climbs the jade-green tower.

lines.py: hū jiàn mò tóu yáng liǔ sè
lines.lit: Suddenly she sees the colour of the willows by the road,
lines.en: Then she sees the willows greening along the road,

lines.py: huǐ jiào fū xù mì fēng hóu
lines.lit: and regrets making her husband go seek a noble title.
lines.en: and wishes she had never sent her husband off to chase a title.

words.note: 现代汉语“闺女”“闺蜜”还保留这个字。
少：读 shào，年轻。现代汉语仍用。

words.en: fully made up; dressed with care
words.note: 古语，现代汉语说“盛装打扮”。
陌：田间小路。现代汉语“陌生”的“陌”。
柳色变绿，表示春天来了。
古义“让、使”，现代汉语说“叫”“让”。
现代汉语说“丈夫”；“女婿”的“婿”。
觅：寻找，现代汉语“寻觅”。封侯：立功后被封为侯，指建功立业。

imagery.name: 柳
imagery.zh: 柳色又绿，提醒她春天又到、离别已久；柳也让人想起当初折柳送别的情景。
imagery.en: Green willows tell her another spring has come and he has been gone a long time — and recall the willow twig of their parting.

imagery.name: 楼
imagery.zh: 她登上翠楼本想赏春，站得高、看得远，反而看到了引起愁思的杨柳。
imagery.en: She climbs the tower to enjoy spring, but from up high she sees exactly what brings on her longing.

imagery.name: 春
imagery.zh: 春天是美好的季节，越美好，越显得一个人独守的孤单。
imagery.en: Spring is lovely — and the lovelier it is, the lonelier it feels to spend it by herself.
